footerText:
Horizon

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Who makes it

Horizon is made by Ludovic Marie; reach him through lu4ovic.com
(opens in a new tab)
. This site is developed by Anthony S of DezerX
(opens in a new tab)
, who is responsible for it. Horizon contains no Minecraft code, assets or data, and this site offers no game files: you need your own legally obtained copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB.

Licences

Horizon's original work is under the MIT licence
(opens in a new tab)
. The fonts are Geist and Geist Mono, under the SIL Open Font License
(opens in a new tab)
. Every asset on this site is listed in LEGAL.md.

Privacy

This site sets no cookies, has no analytics or trackers and loads nothing from third parties except GitHub. When you open a release, the server keeps a one-way hash of your IP address so that release counts each visitor once; the address itself is never stored. To show the latest releases, patch notes, links and contributors, your browser asks api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com for them, and avatars.githubusercontent.com for the contributors' pictures; GitHub's privacy statement
(opens in a new tab)
 covers those requests. The launcher sends nothing unless you allow it: what it can send, and how to delete it
(opens in a new tab)
.

Privacy policy

Made in the open, in Rust.
